document.abstract: This standard specifies the dimensions and location of the cartridge aperture, pressure pad, and characteristics necessary for its appropriate flatness, clearance, and location of film in the camera aperture of 200-ft (60-m) capacity 8-mm type S model 1 sound motion-picture film camera cartridges.
